Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

About the Role

As a Senior Full Stack Engineer on the Platform Team, you will develop and operate Alpaca’s authentication, authorization, and Identity Provider (IdP) systems - the systems that handle user login, access control, and secure access across our APIs, customer products, and internal tools.

We are looking for experienced engineers who are comfortable owning services end to end: API design, data modeling, deployments, and production debugging. Most of your time will be spent writing Go (backend services, gRPC/REST APIs, shared client libraries), with meaningful work in React/TypeScript for auth-related UI, and occasionally Java for identity-provider extensions. You will also work with Helm charts, analyze logs and metrics, manage deployments, and help other teams to integrate with our services.

Things You Get To Do

  • Build and improve authentication-related experiences in customer and partner web applications, including login, permissions, and credential management.
  • Develop and maintain the platform’s authentication, authorization, and IdP services.
  • Create and evolve shared libraries and SDKs.
  • Integrate with identity providers and keep login and access policies working reliably across products.
  • Deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot identity services in production.
  • Help modernize legacy authentication patterns as the platform evolves.
  • Own work end to end, from requirements through delivery and follow-up.
  • Collaborate with other engineering teams on identity and access integration.
  • Maintain high code quality, write tests, and participate in code reviews.
  • Help investigate incidents and bugs, including on-call rotation.

Who You Are (must-haves)

  • You have 5+ years of experience writing code in strongly-typed languages, with at least one year of experience in Go.
  • You have experience building web applications with React and TypeScript.
  • You have worked with relational databases before - we use PostgreSQL, but we are not particularly picky about this one as long as you have a solid grasp on the fundamentals.
  • You have worked at a startup before - you thrive in ambiguous environments, embrace changing priorities, know when to balance technical debt with speed, and proactively tackle whatever needs to get done without relying on pre-existing processes or documentation.
  • You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.
  • You have worked at least 3 years on systems at scale.

Who You Might Be (nice-to-haves)

  • You know what a JWT token is, and how OpenID Connect and SAML work. Maybe you even heard about Keycloak, or have worked on authentication systems before.
  • You have experience with role-based access control.
  • You have built or maintained OpenAPI-driven HTTP APIs.
  • You are familiar with Kubernetes and Helm.
  • You have experience with Java.
  • You understand how Kafka works - maybe you even worked with Redpanda before.
  • You have experience with Grafana’s observability stack - Prometheus, Tempo and all the rest. You might have even written a PromQL query for a new alert once or twice.

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe’s Workplace team is responsible for delivering welcoming, functional, and beautiful environments across the globe, and for ensuring that Stripe’s real estate portfolio evolves to stay aligned with our mission and the needs of our users.

What you’ll do

As a Workplace Design Coordinator at Stripe, you will help maintain and improve design quality across our global office portfolio. In this role, you will manage design standards and portfolio knowledge, review test fits and design submissions, identify design improvements for existing sites, and support strategic design programs spanning vendor partnerships, wellness, sustainability, and practical applications of artificial intelligence (AI).

The ideal candidate combines strong design judgment with excellent communication and organizational skills, research chops, and follow-through. You can evaluate design information, synthesize findings, maintain clear documentation, and coordinate work across cross-functional internal teams and external partners with tact and precision.

Responsibilities

  • Design standards and portfolio knowledge: Maintain Workplace Design resources, including design guidelines, office categories, project books, and portfolio documentation; support updates to guidelines incorporating learnings from completed projects and portfolio audits; and create self-service tools that help internal teams and external partners understand and apply design standards
  • Design review and portfolio improvements: Review test fits, design presentations, drawings, material selections, and project documentation to identify inconsistencies and provide design feedback, including what needs to change and why; partner with regional teams to audit and update existing offices, identify and understand user feedback and trends, and track recurring design issues to inform future recommendations and small-scale pilots
  • Strategic design programs: Coordinate design work streams for bulk-deal and strategic vendor partnerships, and support wellness, sustainability, and inclusive design goals by establishing practical ways to track progress and research compliant products
  • Innovation and practical AI: Explore, test, and document practical applications of AI for design research, documentation, portfolio analysis, and knowledge sharing, and translate pilot results into actionable guidance or self-service tools
  • Cross-functional collaboration: Partner effectively with internal stakeholders, consultants, vendors, and cross-functional teams, including those working on audiovisual (AV)-integrated spaces, to deliver consistent design execution across portfolio touch points
  • This role requires domestic and international travel

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in interior design, architecture, design strategy, or a related field; experience in workplace design, interior design, architecture, or design strategy; and strong visual and spatial design judgment, design acumen, and familiarity with workplace wellness, sustainable design, accessibility, or inclusive design principles
  • Proven experience reading and reviewing architectural plans, test fits, design drawings, material selections, and specifications; strong research and problem-solving skills; and a track record of translating research findings into actionable design recommendations
  • Proficiency with design tools such as Revit, AutoCAD, and/or Bluebeam, planning applications such as Asana, and Google Drive and Google Slides
  • Curiosity about AI and emerging tools, paired with a practical, thoughtful approach to experimentation and workflow enhancement
  • Ability to independently manage defined work streams while seeking direction on novel, ambiguous, or high-impact decisions; excellent organizational skills and attention to detail; and strong leadership, relationship management, and written, visual, and verbal communication skills

Preferred qualifications

  • National Council for Interior Design Qualification (NCIDQ) certification or an architecture license, including either credential in progress
  • Experience and/or interest in sustainable design and wellness, including WELL, Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design (LEED), or similar standards
  • 5+ years of experience in technology-forward workplace design
  • Design experience with hospitality, food and beverage spaces, or event spaces
  • Strong cross-functional partnership experience, particularly with AV-integrated spaces
  • Knowledge of Photoshop, Illustrator, SketchUp, and 3ds Max
  • Experience with Rhino and Grasshopper

About Us

DriveWealth is on a mission to make investing easier. We believe that everyone should have the ability to control their financial future, and that access to financial markets should not be limited by geography, wealth, or legacy systems. We are a global B2B financial technology organization dedicated to democratizing access to financial independence around the world. Our mission is realized through an API-based platform, empowering our partners to offer seamless investing and trading experiences to clients worldwide, all from their mobile devices. Our technology provides partners with a modern, extensible toolkit, enabling traditional investment workflows and innovative techniques like fractional share ownership. DriveWealth has evolved into a global platform offering trading of US equities, mutual funds, ETFs, fixed income, and options.

There’s never been a better time to build a category-defining business and there has rarely been a team better positioned for this opportunity. Our culture blends the pace and agility of a fintech start-up with the impact, stability, and discipline of Wall Street. We encourage creativity and experimentation while ensuring institutional-grade execution and regulatory compliance in everything we do. Join us and help build the future of global investing!

About the Role

DriveWealth LLC is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Security & Threat Operations Manager to build and mature the function protecting our brokerage platform and corporate environment. Reporting to the Chief Information Security Officer, you will grow and lead the team, establish its operating model and roadmap, and deliver measurable improvements in threat detection, investigation, incident response, and exposure management.


In this hands-on leadership role, you will own detection content and the exposure management lifecycle, security monitoring and incident response, operation and tuning of security controls, and turn threat intelligence into defensive improvements. You will act as Incident Commander during significant security incidents and coordinate response across technical and business teams. Partnering with Security Engineering, DevOps & Platform, and Product & Engineering, you will ensure defenses evolve along with our AWS platform, Kubernetes services, low-latency trading infrastructure, and corporate technology within an innovative and entrepreneurial culture.

What You’ll Do

Program Maturity & Team Leadership

  • Program Development: Mature Security & Threat Operations through a measurable roadmap, defined operating model, appropriate monitoring coverage, escalation procedures, and service provider oversight.
  • Team Development: Grow and lead the team through hiring, coaching, training, career development, and performance management.

Threat Detection, Investigation & Intelligence

  • Detection Engineering: Own the detection program incorporating threat intelligence, content development, proactive hunting, and validation through attack simulations and purple-team exercises. Treat detection content development as an engineering discipline.
  • Monitoring & Investigation: Own security monitoring and investigation across product and corporate environments, including phishing, malware, credential compromise, API abuse, DDoS, and insider threats.
  • Digital Risk Monitoring: Own digital risk monitoring covering external attack surfaces, leaked credentials, exposed data, impersonation, phishing domains, and takedown coordination.

Incident Response

  • Automated Response: Partner with Security Engineering to build pre-defined automated security response actions. Coordinate with business leaders on required response actions which cannot be automated or which require compensating actions to prevent unnecessary business disruption.
  • Incident Management: Own the incident response lifecycle as Incident Commander, including preparedness, forensic evidence handling, containment, recovery validation, regulatory coordination, and post-incident improvement.

Exposure Management & Control Operations

  • Exposure Management: Own the exposure management lifecycle from discovery through verified closure, coordinating remediation with accountable system and product owners.
  • Control Operations: Own the operation and tuning of operational security controls, such as DLP, WAF, email filtering, and identity compromise prevention in partnership with Security Engineering, DevOps & Platform, and Product & Engineering to meet evolving product and corporate technology requirements.

Compliance & Assurance

  • Regulatory Controls: Partner with Legal, Compliance, Security Engineering and GRC to implement SEC and FINRA requirements, including SEC Rule 17a-3 and 17a-4 controls supporting record capture, preservation, integrity, access, and retrieval.
  • Control Assurance: Partner with Security Engineering to automate control validation and evidence collection. Support audits and regulatory examinations, and drive remediation of technical findings.

You Bring

  • 10+ years in security operations, detection engineering, incident response, or related disciplines, including 3+ years managing technical teams and experience building or maturing an operations function.
  • Demonstrated experience serving as Incident Commander during significant security incidents, making decisions under pressure, coordinating multiple teams, and communicating clearly with executives and business stakeholders.
  • Strong hands-on expertise in threat intelligence, detection content development, SIEM and endpoint analytics, investigation, threat hunting, and defensive validation.
  • Practical scripting or query skills in Python, SQL, or comparable languages.
  • Working knowledge of AWS, Kubernetes, API security, identity, and Windows/macOS endpoint telemetry. Experience supporting production environments with demanding availability and latency requirements is preferred.
  • Experience creating, operating, and tuning preventive controls such as DLP, WAF, and email filtering while managing false positives and business impact.
  • Experience investigating insider threats and digital risks such as exposed credentials, impersonation, and phishing domains, with appropriate handling of sensitive information and coordination with HR and Legal.
  • Strong people leadership, process design, and prioritization skills, with the ability to influence Engineering and IT, manage competing operational demands, and support on-call escalation and incident response outside normal business hours.
  • Familiarity with NIST CSF, incident response practices, and MITRE ATT&CK. Experience in regulated financial services, including SEC/FINRA environments and applicable incident, data protection, and recordkeeping obligations, is preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience. Relevant certifications such as CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, or GCFA are a plus.

Location

This role is open to candidates in the following locations: New York City, Chicago, Austin, Dallas, Denver, Miami, San Francisco Bay Area, or Seattle. 

  • If based in New York or Chicago: This role is expected to come into the office on a cadence set by the Hiring Manager/Team.
  • If based in Austin, Dallas, Denver, Miami, San Francisco, or Seattle: This is a fully remote role, though you may need to visit our onsite offices from time to time.
  • If you're not based in one of the locations listed above, this role is not a fit, and we cannot accommodate remote work outside these locations.
  • Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. DriveWealth does not sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.

Pay Range: $200,000 – $250,000 USD

Working at DriveWealth

We do our best work when we're in the same room. To maintain the speed our partners expect, our New York, Chicago, and Lithuania teams work in office on a hybrid schedule. We've found that being physically side-by-side is the only way to solve complex problems in real-time and stay truly accountable to the products we ship. When you're here, you're working directly with the people making the decisions.

To support that work, we provide competitive compensation, equity, and a 401(k) match. We also offer Medical insurance, Dental insurance, Vision insurance, Disability insurance, and Paid Parental Leave, along with a wellness reimbursement, a company-provided phone, and a personal development allowance. Finally, we value the time you spend away from the office with generous Paid Time Off (PTO) and observed holidays.

Work Authorization

Applicants must possess the legal right to work in the country where the position is located at the time of application. DriveWealth requires all employees to provide original documentation verifying their work authorization on or before their first day of employment.

For US-based roles: Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without the need for current or future visa sponsorship. DriveWealth does not provide visa sponsorship or support for employment authorization, including transfers, at this time. Offers of employment are strictly contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the Company.

How We Think About AI

We leverage AI to work smarter and move faster. We seek AI-curious talent who are proactive about using emerging tools to increase signal quality, reduce friction, and improve outcomes to deliver products faster, provide better service to our partners, and to streamline processes. Your ability to leverage our internal tools and technology to drive results is as important to us as your core domain expertise.

Compensation

Pay is generally based on the level, complexity, responsibility, location, and job duties/requirements of the specific position. We then source candidates with the requisite skills, expertise, education, training, and experience.  If you are selected for an interview, please feel welcome to speak to a recruiter about our compensation philosophy and other available benefits. This role is eligible for base, bonus, equity, 401(k) match, and heavily subsidized benefits and perks.

Equal Employment Opportunity

To build technology and products that are used and loved by people and solve real-world problems, we need to build a team with many different perspectives and experiences. We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. 

Agency Disclaimer

DriveWealth does not accept agency resumes. Do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, employees, or any other organization location. DriveWealth is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.
About the role

We're looking for an experienced Business Development leader to grow Bybit Card, Bybit Pay and Bybit Fiat services through affiliates, KOLs, creators and communities. You'll directly manage a regional team of Business Developers and be responsible for turning affiliate activity into profitable new-user growth, first transactions, payment volume and revenue.

You'll hire and coach Business Developers, set regional priorities and incentives, and put clear processes in place to track results across markets. You'll also work with Payments leadership to turn product launches into campaigns. Selected B2B opportunities are part of the role, but dedicated internal teams handle the deeper negotiation, contracting and onboarding of qualified merchant and PSP leads.

What you will own
  • Hire, coach and manage Business Developers across priority markets. Set clear responsibilities and targets, recognize strong performance and address gaps early.
  • Decide where the team focuses its time and resources based on regional opportunities, partner performance and business priorities.
  • Grow affiliate, KOL, creator and community channels. Help BDs find the right partners, negotiate terms, get them active and develop relationships that continue to perform.
  • Build repeatable affiliate plans for Card, Pay and Fiat product launches, with the campaigns, content, landing pages and tracking needed to support them.
  • Set commission and incentive structures for BDs and partners. Reward meaningful promotion and measurable acquisition while keeping partner economics sustainable.
  • Put clear processes in place for pipeline management, account ownership, reporting and forecasting. Use the data to identify what works and replicate it across regions.
  • Help the team identify and qualify merchant, PSP and other payments opportunities, then hand strong leads to the relevant internal teams. Support strategic discussions when senior BD input is needed.
  • Work with Marketing, Growth, Product, Operations, Legal, Compliance and Finance to resolve blockers and keep partner activity moving.
What success looks like
  • Affiliate and KOL partners consistently promote the right products and bring in users who activate and transact.
  • The team can show results by market, BD, partner and channel, including first transactions, payment volume and revenue.
  • New launches have a reliable plan for activating relevant partners quickly.
  • BDs know what they own and can execute with limited day-to-day escalation to Payments leadership.
  • Incentives support growth without rewarding low-quality acquisition or unsustainable partner spend.
What we are looking for
  • Experience directly leading, hiring and developing a regional or distributed BD, affiliate or partnerships team.
  • A track record of building an affiliate or partner-led growth program from the ground up, including its incentives, processes and performance measures.
  • Strong knowledge of KOL, creator, affiliate and community acquisition, and the ability to judge partner quality and return on investment.
  • Experience managing a team against measurable acquisition, transaction-volume or revenue goals, including addressing underperformance.
  • The ability to turn business priorities into clear plans for a team and use performance data to change course when needed.
  • Commercial negotiation skills and the judgment to support important partnerships without losing focus on team performance.
  • Experience in crypto, iGaming, fintech, consumer apps or another affiliate-led business is highly desirable. An existing partner network is a strong plus; knowledge of merchants and PSPs is also useful.

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.

Who we are 

We simplify wealth creation. Our user-friendly, trade-everything platform empowers both first-time investors and seasoned experts to invest in the cryptocurrencies, crypto indices, stocks*, precious metals and commodities* they want — with any sized budget, 24/7. It’s these diverse perspectives and innovative minds operating as ONE TEAM that keep Bitpanda at the cutting edge of our industry. So if you’re someone who thinks big, moves fast and wants to make an impact right from day one, then get ready to join our industry-changing team. Let’s go!

 

Your Mission

Joining our Group Reporting team, you will contribute to group consolidation activities and handle day-to-day IFRS accounting topics. You will manage core Intercompany reconciliations to resolve discrepancies and support timely, accurate financial closes. As an active team contributor assisting with year-end audits and financial statement disclosures, you will help maintain high reporting standards and streamline our finance operations.

What You'll Do

  • 12+ years of customer-facing experience in customer success, account management, or sales with 5 years of people management experience
  • Payments or Fintech experience and/or experience in a complex SaaS consumption environment

  • Ability to operate in a high-growth environment and work through ambiguity to solve complex customer and business problems

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Payouts and FX team helps global businesses manage their money wherever it flows. We own Stripe's FX and multi-currency management products—including FX Acquiring, Multicurrency Settlement (MCS), and Currency Conversion—which together serve tens of thousands of global merchants and platforms. Our team works at the intersection of payments, treasury, and financial infrastructure, helping businesses reduce FX costs, eliminate third-party dependencies, and consolidate their multi-currency operations onto Stripe.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will own the full commercial cycle—prospecting, structuring, closing, and activating deals—across Stripe's FX Acquiring, Multicurrency Settlement (MCS), and Currency Conversion (ICC) products. You will engage CFO- and Treasurer-level stakeholders at global merchants and platforms, positioning Stripe's multi-currency suite as the complete alternative to standalone FX management providers. You will also serve as a product specialist for the broader Account Executive team, building the playbooks, deal structures, and GTM motion that scale this business.

Responsibilities

  • Own quota and commercial responsibility across FX Acquiring, Multicurrency Settlement, and Currency Conversion, prospecting and closing deals with global merchants and platforms
  • Structure and negotiate holistic multi-currency deals that bundle MCS and Currency Conversion, pricing across both products to deliver merchant value while capturing the full multi-currency management relationship for Stripe
  • Engage C-suite and treasury stakeholders—including CFOs, Treasurers, and Engineering leaders—to articulate Stripe's multi-currency value proposition and displace competitors managing FX flows off-platform
  • Serve as the FX and multi-currency GTM product specialist for the broader Account Executive team, partnering on complex deals and helping build repeatable sales motions
  • Build and execute go-to-market strategies for new product segments, including pitch frameworks, displacement playbooks, and bundled pricing approaches
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with product, treasury, and core account teams to support merchant activation, resolve deal blockers, and feed market intelligence back into product development

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying B2B sales experience in payments, fintech, or financial infrastructure
  • Demonstrated knowledge of FX and treasury concepts across multiple geographies, including currency risk, settlement mechanics, and cross-border payment flows
  • Experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles involving finance and engineering leadership
  • Track record of consultative, product-led selling with demonstrated competitive displacement wins

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience building a go-to-market motion for a new product or market segment, from initial targeting through to scaled execution
